text: Long catch-up with Nora over coffee. Her knee op is booked for 14 November at the General, and she's dreading the anaesthetic more than the surgery. Her son Patrick is driving her in. I should text her the night before.
Ahmed's still obsessed with the darts. He's got tickets for the Ally Pally in December with his brother Yusuf. Birthday is 3rd of January, and he mentioned wanting a proper set of tungsten darts.

Mai and Bao came round for dinner. Bao is finally having his hernia repair next Tuesday, day case, home the same evening. Mai's taking the week off to look after him. Their cat Pepper is not impressed with the fuss.
Rang Mabel. Hip is healing well, physio twice a week now, walking to the corner shop with a stick. She sounded much brighter than last month.
Need to pick up Tariq's birthday card before Friday. He's into vinyl at the moment, mostly 70s soul, so maybe a record token.

Had lunch with Keisha and Obi. Keisha just started pottery classes on Wednesday evenings and is already making wonky mugs for everyone. Obi's mum had a fall last week and is in hospital, he's been back and forth every day and looks shattered. Don't forget to ask Obi how his mum is getting on.
Henrik is running the Berlin half in March. Training five mornings a week. Bit nervous about his calf.
Thomas Baker turned 50 on Saturday, missed the party because of work. Must send something belated, he's mad on Formula 1, Ferrari specifically.
Quick one: dentist for me on 22/10 at 9:15. Then pick up prescription.

Yasmin's surgery got cancelled again, third time now. Hospital says maybe in the new year. She's fed up and in a lot of pain. Her husband Ivan is doing most of the school runs. Remind me to drop round some food at the weekend.
Caught up with Gareth after five a side. He's been doing loads of fly fishing up in Wales, ties his own flies now. His daughter starts at Cardiff uni next September, he's already panicking about it.
Chiara's 30th is on the 9th of December, she's doing a karaoke night in town. She loves anything Studio Ghibli, keeps saying she wants the Totoro lamp.
Pedro had his gallbladder out on Monday. Home now, sore but OK. Sister Rana is staying with him till Sunday. I should call him Thursday to see how he's doing.
Kasia says the book club is doing Middlemarch next, which she is not thrilled about. Meeting's on the 2nd of November at hers.

Dinner with Julien and his partner Eva last night. They're off to Lisbon for their anniversary on 18 November. Julien is getting really into jazz piano, takes lessons with an old guy in Hackney on Tuesdays. Eva has a scan in a fortnight for her back, she's been off work since September. Need to message Eva after the scan.
Mustafa's dog Simba is having a tumour removed tomorrow morning. He's in bits about it.
Gintaras finally got his allotment plot. Growing chillies and garlic, very proud of himself. Says he'll bring me some jars of pickled stuff.
Haruto Tanaka - Hari to everyone - has his black belt grading in Judo this Saturday. He's been training every night. Wish him luck Friday.
Bought birthday stuff for Mehmet: the Galatasaray scarf and a Turkish coffee pot. Party is Sunday at his brother's.

Dev had a cataract op on his left eye last week. Not allowed to drive for a bit, so Olga's taking him to the follow-up appointment on the 28th. He's already bored and listening to cricket podcasts all day.

Alana's mum is in for a bypass on 6 Nov. Alana is pretty scared, she's the only one nearby since her brothers live in Canada. Offered to do the hospital run if needed. Don't forget to text Alana on the 6th.
Yaw and Keisha are expecting! Due in April. Yaw is already reading every baby book going.
Ricardo's doing a ceramics course now, plus still the Saturday parkrun. Birthday's the 27th, he dropped a hint about wanting a decent apron.
Rana had her wisdom teeth out yesterday. Face like a hamster apparently. Check on her tomorrow.
The gig with Obi on Friday is off, the band cancelled. He's trying to get refunds.
Mai's grandad Mustafa, Grandpa Moose to the family, is 90 on 4th December. Big family lunch planned. She's making a photo book.

Ivan has been building a model railway in the loft for about three years now, full Swiss mountain layout. His wife Yasmin says it's taking over the house. He wants a particular Märklin locomotive for Christmas, she sent me the link.
Call Nora Friday re her results.

Spent the afternoon with Henrik and his twins. The boys are both mad on Pokemon cards and Henrik is slowly going broke. Their birthday is 12/11, they'll be eight. Henrik's wife Kasia had her ankle in a boot, she rolled it hiking in the Lakes last weekend.
Tariq's dad is having chemo every other Thursday now. Tariq's coping but quiet. Take him for a pint next week.
Note to self: renew the car insurance by 30th October, and book the MOT for some time next week.
Patrick plays bass in a covers band, they've got a gig at the Red Lion on 15 Nov. Asked if I'd come, said yes.

Mabel's 80th is next Sunday. Her daughter Chiara is organising afternoon tea at the garden centre. Mabel loves crosswords and anything with hedgehogs on it. I should get her a nice crossword book and a card. Also need to ask Chiara what time it starts.
Olga says Dev's recovery is going slower than expected, the eye's still blurry. Follow-up got moved to 5th November. She's worried but trying not to show it.
Met Mehmet's new girlfriend, Ana. Seems lovely, works as a vet nurse.
Gareth's son Tom passed his driving test this morning, first go! Gareth said he barely slept last night worrying about it. Send Tom a congrats message.
Yusuf had keyhole surgery on his shoulder back in August and has been doing rehab ever since. Says he's back at the climbing wall on Wednesday for the first time. Ask how it went.

Long walk with Pedro and Ahmed. Pedro's reading his way through every Terry Pratchett book in order, he's on Night Watch. Ahmed's wife is having a C-section on the 3rd of December, he's nervous, their first. Pedro's birthday is the week after, on the 10th. Remind me to sort a present for Pedro, he wants the illustrated Colour of Magic.
Rang about the boiler. Engineer coming Thursday between 8 and 12.
Thomas had a scare with chest pains last Tuesday, ended up in A&E overnight. All tests came back fine, they think it was reflux. His wife Mai was furious he didn't call anyone sooner.
Alana's started knitting, of all things. Making a jumper for her niece. Very slow progress.

Bao turns 40 on 21 Nov, Mai's throwing a surprise thing at the Thai place on the Saturday. Bao is into board games, especially Wingspan and anything with birds. Chipping in with Keisha and Yaw for the expansion pack.
Haruto's mum came out of hospital yesterday after her stroke. Long road ahead, speech is affected. He's moving back home for a few months to help. I must ring him at the weekend.
Eva's scan was clear! No surgery needed, just more physio. She's back at work on Monday.
Chess club with Gintaras and Ivan tonight. Gintaras is entering the county rapidplay in January and is weirdly nervous about it. Ivan beat me twice, as usual.
Kasia's birthday 19/01. Likes gin, candles, and the Archers. Write it down before I forget.
Obi's mum has been moved to a rehab ward and should be home in about two weeks. He sounded relieved. His sister Yasmin is flying in from Lagos on Thursday to help.

Grabbed a coffee with Julien. His band finally has a name and a first gig at the jazz cafe on 7th Dec. He's a wreck about it, says he's never played to strangers. Remind me to get tickets, and text him good luck the day before.
Rana's son Yaw got into the county football squad. Training Tuesday and Thursday nights from now on.
Mustafa says Simba came through the op fine, stitches out in ten days. Lampshade collar, very sorry for himself.
Patrick's mum passed away on Sunday. Funeral is next Friday, 10am, at St Mary's. He's holding it together but only just. I'll go to the funeral. Need to send flowers to the house before then.
Saw Dev at the market. He's finally driving again and back to his watercolours.

Thomas and Mai are doing the Three Peaks in May for the hospice. They're training every weekend, and Thomas has started making a spreadsheet of hill times, as you'd expect. Mai's dad was in that hospice last year, so it means a lot to her. Sponsor them when the page goes live.
Mehmet's knee surgery is on Wednesday 12th. He'll be off work at least six weeks. Can't play padel till spring and is gutted.
Ricardo Barros, Ricky, is retiring at the end of next month after 32 years at the council. Leaving do on the 28th. Collection going round, chip in.
Weekend sorted: Saturday parkrun, Sunday lunch at Mum's, then finish the shelves.

Nora's results were fine, nothing sinister, just needs a follow-up in six months. Her husband Henrik is taking her away to the Cotswolds this weekend to celebrate. She's been obsessed with sourdough lately, so maybe a proving basket for her birthday in March.
Ahmed's baby boy arrived early, born Saturday at 3am! Both well, home tomorrow. Name is Idris. Get a card and a little something.
Keisha has been struggling a bit since the miscarriage in the summer. Today she seemed better, back at pottery and talking about a trip to Ghana with Yaw in February to see his grandmother.
Olga is learning Spanish on Duolingo, 200 day streak. She's off to Seville on 2nd of March with her sister Eva. Also her birthday's the 14th, wants a nice leather notebook.
